description: Requires signing in to GearHost. Create a MySQL or SQL Server database in the user's GearHost account. Each account gets ONE free database (25 MB). If it is already used, the result has status "needs_confirmation", names the free database and lists the paid sizes: tell the user, and only after they agree to a price call again with size and accept_charges:true. Optionally link it to one of the user's CloudSites: its connection string is then set on the site as an environment variable (default name ConnectionStrings__Default). Returns the connection details once, including the password: they are credentials, so do not publish them in a site's public files. Returns structuredContent { status, name, engine, host, port, database, user, password, connection_string, linked_site, env_var }.

accept_charges.description: true only after the user agreed to the size's monthly price.

engine.description: mysql (PHP, WordPress, Node, Python) or sqlserver (.NET). Default mysql.

env_var.description: Optional environment variable name for the link (default ConnectionStrings__Default).

name.description: Database name: letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores, starting with a letter or number, up to 63 characters (e.g. "shop_orders").

site.description: Optional: a CloudSite address in the account to link the database to (list_my_sites shows them).

size.description: Only when the free database is already used: the paid size to start this one at.

name: create_database
title: Create a database
